summary.intent: Complete planning verification for Phase 64 (rotation-soundness-revocation-guarantees) and advance to execution readiness by resolving all plan-checker blockers and passing coverage gates.
summary.outcome: All 3 prior issues resolved (RESEARCH.md open questions marked RESOLVED, VALIDATION.md per-task map added, 64-07 no-double-bump mechanism specified). All 5 requirements covered, 7/7 decisions covered, dependency graph validated acyclic and wave-consistent. STATE.md and ROADMAP.md updated and committed.

repo: Phase 64 covers 8 plans across 6 waves with a strict dependency chain: 64-01/02/03 (wave 1) → 64-04 (wave 2) → 64-05 (wave 3) → 64-06 (wave 4) → 64-07 (wave 5) → 64-08 (wave 6).
VALIDATION.md requires status: final and nyquist_compliant: true plus an 8-row per-task map to pass the plan checker.
RESEARCH.md open questions must be inline-marked with (RESOLVED) in the section header to clear the blocker gate.
Plan actions must describe mechanisms in prose only — no fenced code blocks allowed in <action> blocks.
The no-double-bump mechanism is implemented as a per-node convergence guard plus fresh-job idempotency, tested by RED Test 5 (node at baseline+1 not re-rotated under a fresh job record).
workflow: Plan verification runs in iterations; the checker returns structured tables for prior-issue resolution, coverage, and per-plan validity — making it easy to confirm fixes without re-reading raw files.
Requirements and decision coverage gates (§13, §13a) are run as separate bash steps after the plan-checker agent returns, not inline.
STATE.md and ROADMAP.md bookkeeping (§13b/13c) are committed separately from PLAN.md files, allowing signing hooks to run independently.
Background task notifications signal commit completion; the assistant verifies markers in the commit before spawning the next subagent.

friction: Two verification iterations were required — the first run surfaced 1 blocker and 2 warnings that needed doc edits and a re-commit before re-verification.
The plan-checker subagent takes 1–5 minutes with no intermediate output, requiring a wait with no progress signal.
open_items: Phase 65, 66, and 68 scope explicitly deferred — confirmed not pulled forward into Phase 64 plans.
Execution of Phase 64 (run /gsd-execute-phase 64) is the next step but was not started in this session.
